name: io.github.faucetdb/faucet
title: Faucet
description: SQL database to MCP tools and REST API: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, Snowflake.

environmentVariables.name: FAUCET_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Faucet data directory holding the databases you connected with `faucet serve` or `faucet db add`. Default: ~/.faucet. stdio mode runs with local admin rights.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Faucet API key (create one on the API keys page of the admin UI); its role's RBAC rules apply to every tool call.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish Faucet's HTTP port (admin UI, REST API and /mcp)

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Persist Faucet's config (databases, roles, API keys)
